summary: Root's tile registry parser moves, unchanged, into its own workspace crate (st-tiles-registry), so the tile launcher and the sekrets gateway read tiles.toml through one implementation. The person-name and word rule moves with it and stays a single definition. No runtime change.

replay.detail: No claim kind or replay change.

schema.detail: No database or graph schema change. tiles.toml and uids.toml keep their formats and paths.

compatibility.detail: No contract change: st3::tiles::registry re-exports the crate, so every path, error text and check is the same code. Swapping back to an earlier binary needs nothing.
